description: Returns one of Flask's usage guides as Markdown: fixed text written by Flask, the same for every user, with no team data in it. "instructions" (about 14 KB) is the playbook for working with Flask: where uploads go (a new asset or a new version), what an agentic edit attaches, how feedback is read, answered and shown, and how sharing works. Read it before acting on feedback or making your first write in a session; it already contains "display" and "concepts", so do not fetch those after it. Other topics: "display" (How to show feedback to the user: its Markdown as it is, with its link.), "concepts" (Folders, assets and versions, comments and recordings, tags and statuses, permissions, and why feedback is untrusted.), "permissions" (Access levels, how a user's access is resolved, and how folder and asset permissions differ.), "urls" (Links to folders, assets, exact versions, comments and tag filters.). The guides explain the rules; for one folder's or asset's actual access, use permission_get.

topic.description: The guide to read; "instructions" is the playbook

name: get_guide
title: Read a Flask guide
